name: axiom
description: Guidance-first Codex engineering with almost-free proactive parallel Luna MAX workers, fresh Sol XHIGH review, context isolation, safe Git coordination, and an optional local observability dashboard.

interface.longDescription: Axiom is a guidance-first Codex plugin for non-trivial software engineering. Main Sol owns intent, architecture, integration, review adjudication, and final acceptance; under Axiom v0.1.4 model economics, Luna MAX worker usage is treated as almost free so useful bounded delegation and parallel fan-out are not suppressed to conserve model usage; meaningful changes receive fresh direct-spawn Sol XHIGH review with same-reviewer continuity. The optional local read-only Dashboard observes Codex Rollout Trace, agent parallelism, review evidence, token distribution, Git state, and Axiom principle compliance without turning Axiom into a workflow engine or control plane.
defaultPrompt: Use $axiom:axiom to implement this change with efficient delegation and independent review.
Use $axiom:axiom to investigate this codebase while keeping Main context concise.
Use $axiom:axiom-dashboard to open the local read-only Axiom Dashboard for this repository.
